name: Mudbray (CobbleEffort form)
look: near-black with white skeleton markings, a white skull face, a black side-swept fringe with a purple streak and a black tail with red X marks
entry: It dyes its mane black, lets its fringe fall over its eyes and wears the pattern of a skeleton on its hide. It sulks in the shadows and kicks at anyone who calls it a phase.
how: Wild: uncommon in dark forests, badlands and spooky biomes.
